definitions.dwell: departure minus arrival at section stations; a call belongs to its arrival day
definitions.loads_per_day: distinct loads per adjacent block section by arrival day; month figure is the mean over days with traffic on the block
definitions.passenger_delay: not available: the log has no passenger actuals
definitions.through_transit: last minus first arrival at section stations, loads calling at >= min stations; a load belongs to the day it enters the section

definitions.detention_hours: sum over section calls of (dwell - 30 min), where positive
definitions.running_excess: block run time above the p10 of its block, direction and loaded/empty
definitions.stabled_loads: loads with a section stop longer than 360 min
